messages:
sam (product): quick sync — we need to lock the PRD acceptance criteria for the Optimize toolkit RFC (batching / caching / quantization). customers are pressing for actionable guidance and a safe rollout path.

maya (eng-ml): high level: we should separate recommendations vs automated config. customers want 'runbooks' + an api to suggest profiles.

ryan (eng-platform): +1. also need to define SLAs for any automated changes (e.g., auto-quantize). default should be opt-in, canary first.

carlos (eng-runtime): technical constraints: not all models support fast quant paths. acceptance criteria must include model-compatibility matrix and fallback behavior.

anya (sre): ops concerns: caching changes can add state that needs eviction and SLO safety nets. include rollback steps and monitoring thresholds.

sam (product): draft acceptance checklist proposal: 1) docs: clear decision matrix for batching/caching/quant decisions. 2) safe rollout: canary + automatic rollback triggers. 3) metrics: latency, p95, token-cost delta, and quality regression alarm based on eval prompts. 4) migration guide for Dedicated/Private.

maya (eng-ml): nit: for quality regression alarm we need a minimal eval set and a baseline scoring function (exact-match + log-prob thresholds). add tolerance bands per model family.

ryan (eng-platform): canary plan sketch: 5% traffic -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% with manual gates at each step. rules: if p95 increases > 25ms or quality drop > 2% -> automatic rollback. can we make those thresholds configurable per customer?

carlos (eng-runtime): yes, flags per deployment. but implement fallback routing to previous model variant so requests keep flowing while rollback finishes. example config snippet: 
```json
{
  "canary": {"steps": [5,25,50], "metric_triggers": {"p95_ms": 25, "quality_drop_pct": 2}}
}
```

anya (sre): add circuit-breaker: if error rate > 0.5% for 5m -> tip traffic to safe tier. and include alerting runbook link: <https://go.redwood/runbooks/optimize-canary>.

sam (product): scope negotiation: customers wanted automatic quant recommendation. engineering hesitant to auto-apply. proposal: MVP = recommendation UI + CI check (suggested profile + estimated savings/latency). v2 = opt-in auto-apply with canary rules.

maya (eng-ml): agree. MVP acceptance: recommendations must be reproducible (seeded evals), saving estimates based on historical token mix, and a confidence score. docs for edge cases (short-sequence workloads, embeddings) required.

ryan (eng-platform): implementation tasks: a) recommendation engine service b) UI + API c) canary runner d) metrics/alerting integration. estimate: 6w for MVP with 2 engineers + 1 SRE part-time.

carlos (eng-runtime): we need unit tests for quantized paths and integration tests for KV cache consistency across cached-prefixes. add test matrix to PRD.

sam (product): acceptance criteria summary to add to PRD paragraph: - Recommendation accuracy >= X%? (we need to pick a number) - Canary rollouts implemented with configurable thresholds - Documentation + runbooks present - Integration tests covering model fallbacks - Billing/estimate examples included.

maya (eng-ml): for "recommendation accuracy" let's avoid a single % — instead require case coverage: small/medium/long sequences and embedding-only workloads covered, and observed cost delta within +/- 10% of estimate on a holdout set.

anya (sre): ask: who owns post-launch monitoring? propose "platform oncall" initial 2w then handoff to customer's SRE if Dedicated/Private. include contact routing.

sam (product): good. action items: @maya write acceptance criteria text for PRD (due EOD tomorrow). @ryan add canary workflow + config example to repo. @carlos add test matrix + fallback behavior. @anya draft runbook snippets and alert thresholds. I'll collate and update PRD.

dev-bot: deploy-checklist: PRD-snapshot created: https://redwood.docs/prd/optimize-toolkit-1917601234

maya (eng-ml): acked — will post a short PR with criteria and a minimal eval set.

ryan (eng-platform): will prototype canary runner config and push under infra/optimize/canary.

carlos (eng-runtime): will start a test-plan doc and include quant smoke tests.

anya (sre): will draft alerts + runbook and add playbook steps for rollback and paging paths.

sam (product): thanks everyone. if no objections I'll fold this into PRD by EOD Fri. :thumbsup:
